description: Use this when the couple asks about the events or the times of their own wedding. The signed-in couple's own wedding events on Zola, for example the rehearsal dinner, ceremony, and reception: the name, type, local start and end time with the time zone, venue, address, attire, note, and meal options of each event. For the RSVP counts of each event, use zola_get_my_rsvp_overview. For the guests of an event, give its event_id to zola_search_my_guests. Requires Zola sign-in. Do not use for an example schedule of a wedding day: use zola_get_wedding_day_timeline_template.
name: zola_list_my_wedding_events

outputSchema.description: The events of the wedding, in the order of their start time

meal_options.description: The names of the meal options of the event. A meal of zola_record_my_rsvp is 1 of them. Empty when the event has no meal options

on_website.description: The event shows on the wedding website

start_local.description: Local time of the event, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, in timezone

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the event

exists.description: False when the signed-in user has no wedding on Zola

links.description: The zola.com pages for this data

title: List My Wedding Events
